'''Koblus "Ko" Sornell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who served the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], she served as a signals expert during the invasion of [[Zongorlu]]. Sornell was also present during the [[Essien landing]] with her young son, [[Gheedor Sornell]]. During the battle, her [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] crashed into a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Skiff/Legends|command skiff]] commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dallan Morvis]] by the shoreline, leaving her and Gheedor in the [[Water/Legends|water]].<ref name="KotOR War 1" />

==Biography==
She lived the nomadic lifestyle of a Mandalorian with her husband, [[Haarm Sornell]], and three children: a boy named [[Gheedor Sornell|Gheedor]], a younger daughter, and an infant son. While on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], she revealed that she was expecting a fourth child.

During a [[Taris Siege|siege]] on the planet [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Sornell helped establish a signal and communication post where she and the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] fought through the technical fields. She decided to coordinate on the planet while she and the Mandalorians were led by [[Cassus Fett]]. He led his troops to reach over the helm comlinks which transfers on the publicly accessible [[Z-band]] from [[Serroco]].
